import json, subprocess, sys, os, time
ROOT='/workspace'
def run(payload):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(ROOT,'run.py')], input=json.dumps(payload).encode(), capture_output=True, cwd=ROOT)
    if r.returncode: print('ERR', r.stderr[:300]); raise SystemExit(1)
    return json.loads(r.stdout.decode())

# ---- 3-ary worst case: maximize node count
ops=[]; fib={}
base = [REDACTED:SECRET]
keys=[0, 1, 2]
paths=[[]]
for lvl in range(8):
    paths=[p+[k] for p in paths for k in keys]
print('paths', len(paths))
for i,p in enumerate(paths):
    v = base
    for j,k in enumerate(p):
        v |= k << (58 - 6*j)
    a = '%032x' % v
    ops.append(["put", a, 112, i % 4194303])
    fib[(v, 112)] = i % 4194303
ops.append(["save"]); ops.append(["load_saved",0])
